profile.headline: Senior Software Developer Bringing Designs And Ideas To Life
profile.summary:
I’m a practical innovator, builder, and problem-solver who enjoys turning ideas into tools people can actually use. My approach to technology is grounded in curiosity, purpose, and a willingness to roll up my sleeves and figure things out.

I’m most energized by projects that begin with an unanswered question: Can this process be better? Can this idea become something real? Can technology solve a problem that people have simply learned to live with?

I'm a technical founder who can take a product from design to deployment: UI/UX, frontend, backend, AI. I teach myself whatever I need to learn and go deep until I own it.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Designing, developing, and modernizing internal platforms that streamline operations and connect business processes. Building metal knowledge and content management systems, enhancing reporting and evaluation toolkits, integrating loyalty programs, and developing secure payment integrations across our applications.

Actively involved in R&D by evaluating emerging technologies, leading rapid prototypes and proofs of concept, and now including the process of exploring compliant AI use cases. Ensuring seamless integration with existing systems while maintaining security, accessibility, performance, and digital identity.

Modernizing customer-facing and internal applications, improving reporting clarity, reducing duplication and weak points, and collaborating across teams to deliver scalable solutions aligned with current needs and long-term goals.

positions.title: Assistant Full-Stack Instructor/Part-Time Student
positions.description:
When given the opportunity, I accepted a position to be a TA for a part time coding immersion program
hosted by Tech Talent South.
❖ This course covered Frontend technologies html, css, and vanilla javascript, as well as data manipulation using Ruby and its MVC Framework Ruby On Rails to build full-stack web applications.
❖ Helped students understand the material that the class was going over during the 8 week coding
program as well as help the instructor test students on their knowledge.
❖ Helped to debug and troubleshoot students programming homework and projects. 

This course covered the following topics: 

Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Ruby Gems
HTML, CSS, Bootstrap
JavaScript, jQuery
Deployment
Domain Modeling
Model Associations
APIs
Databases
Git, Github
